name: Encrypted Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, the Encrypted Tablet sends novice troll rogues to Rwag. The rogue trainer inscribes its coded message and keeps his post inside the Den.

sections.title: A Hidden Summons
sections.body: Novice troll rogues receive the Encrypted Tablet when they arrive in the Valley of Trials. Its ciphered words direct them to Rwag, an orc trainer who lives in the Den’s shaded caves. The slate keeps the local shadow operatives’ business discreet while testing whether new recruits can understand its message.

sections.title: Eyes of the Hand
sections.body: Deciphering the tablet brings recruits into contact with the Horde’s wider shadow network. When they report to Rwag, scouts learn that syndicates such as the Shattered Hand watch their progress. The syndicates rely on valley trainers to judge whether prospective cutpurses, spies, and assassins are sharp enough to serve the new nation.

faq.q: What is the Encrypted Tablet used for?
aliases: why do i have encrypted tablet
faq.answer: The Encrypted Tablet directs young troll rogues to report to Rwag, the rogue trainer posted inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Who wrote the message on the tablet?
faq.answer: Rwag, the rogue trainer in the Valley of Trials, wrote the message. He oversees the training of thieves, cutpurses, and assassins for the Horde.

aliases: find rogue trainer valley of trials
faq.answer: Rwag is inside the Den, a cavern complex along the northern ridge of the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

faq.q: What is 'the Hand' mentioned by Rwag?
faq.answer: The Hand is the Shattered Hand, a clandestine order in the Horde’s rogue network. Rwag reports to them on the readiness of new operatives from the Valley.

angles.text: As a rogue, you receive the ciphered slate as your first step into the Horde’s formal ranks. It points you to Rwag’s training in the Den.
As a Darkspear troll training in Durotar, you receive this tablet as proof that your agility and stealth have caught the Valley trainers’ attention.
